messages:
Maya R: Quick thought — for the annual planning offsite (late Sept), can we adopt a 2-track facilitation model: Strategy + Roadmap (product) and Ops & Reliability? I think product track should own initiative prioritization template and launch criteria. Need volunteers for facilitation leads.

Samir K: +1 to 2-track. I can co-facilitate product track. Will build prioritization template (impact, effort, customer signal, risk) and a short example for Redwood Optimize vs Dedicated.

Lee T: I’ll take Ops & Reliability track. AV/infra runbook + incident rolldown simulation. Also can organize staging for live demos.

Priya S: Heads up — customer success wants a slot to present top 6 customer asks and supporting artifacts. Can we reserve a 30m block on day 1?

Alex G: Suggest we lock the facilitator owners and share a prework doc with each attendee 3 weeks ahead. Prework = product one-pager + current metrics + 3 asks. Template:
```
- Initiative name
- Problem statement
- Success criteria (OKR alignment)
- Metrics baseline
- Expected rollout complexity
```

Jo-Ann (ops): Venue update — Shoreline Loft is available Sept 23-24, cap 45, AV included. Catering options: boxed lunches or family-style. Any preference? Dietary notes collected in a form I'll send.

Maya R: Great. Volunteers so far: Samir (prod), Lee (ops). Need one more prod facilitator (rotating). @Alex G any chance you can run prioritization timebox and help score initiatives?

Alex G: Yep I can run scoring + teach the simple ICE-style method we'll use. I'll produce a rubric and a Google Sheet for live scoring.

Priya S: 30m slot confirmed. Will prep the top customer themes doc.

Samir K: Quick facilitation checklist draft:
```
- 5m intro + outcomes
- 20m context + data
- 30m group scoring (live sheet)
- 15m breakout: solution sketches
- 10m alignment & decisions
```

Lee T: AV needs: projector, 2 wireless mics, Zoom bridge, 1 laptop with staging access. Jo-Ann pls confirm with venue.

Jo-Ann (ops): Will confirm and book AV. Also sending the dietary/preferences form by EOD.

planner-bot: Created Google Calendar event "Redwood Annual Planning — Product & Ops" for Sep 23 09:00-17:00 in Shoreline Loft. Attendance: Maya R, Samir K, Lee T, Priya S, Alex G, Jo-Ann (ops)

Maya R: Can we also define 'launch criteria' template per initiative? Prefer binary gates + measurable signal. I'll draft and share tomorrow.

Alex G: Draft a `launch_criteria.md` snippet in the repo under /playbooks and link in the prework.

Priya S: Also recommend adding a customer impact role for each initiative owner — who will take post-launch validation.

Samir K: Sounds good. Action items:
- Samir: draft prioritization template (due in 5 days)
- Alex: scoring sheet + rubric (due in 7 days)
- Lee: ops exercise + AV list (due in 10 days)
- Jo-Ann: venue + catering + form (due in 3 days)
- Maya: launch criteria draft (due tomorrow)
- Priya: customer asks deck (due in 10 days)

Maya R: Thanks all. We'll run a 30m dry run with facilitators two weeks before. Put dry-run availability in the calendar invite or ping here.

Alex G: noted — scheduling dry-run. :thumbsup:

Jo-Ann (ops): booked Shoreline Loft. Email invite sent. Catering preference form: https://forms.gle/redwood-offsite-catering

Samir K: great — moving this to the planning doc: https://docs.google.com/redwood/annual-planning-2025

Maya R: Closing loop — let's keep action items visible and bump if blockers. Appreciate the quick volunteers! :sparkles:
